xffForwardEnabled.description: Enable if you want the Zscaler service to use the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) headers that your on-premises proxy server inserts in outbound HTTP requests.

authRequired.description: Indicates whether "Authentication Required" is enabled in the location template.

cautionEnabled.description: Enable to display an end user notification for unauthenticated traffic. If disabled, the action is treated as an allow-policy.

aupEnabled.description: Enable this feature to display an Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) for unauthenticated traffic and require users to accept it.

aupTimeoutInDays.description: If you enabled aupEnabled, specify in days how frequently the AUP is displayed to users.

ipsControl.description: If you enabled ofwEnabled, enable this for IPS controls for the location template.

enforceBandwidthControl.description: Enable to specify the maximum bandwidth limits for download (Mbps) and upload (Mbps).

upBandwidth.description: If you enabled enforceBandwidthControl, specify the maximum bandwidth for upload (Mbps).

dnBandwidth.description: If you enabled enforceBandwidthControl, specify the maximum bandwidth for download (Mbps).

displayTimeUnit.description: The time unit to display for IP Surrogate idle time to disassociation.

idleTimeInMinutes.description: Idle time to disassociation, in minutes. If a Surrogate IP is enabled, the user mapping idle time is required.

surrogateIPEnforcedForKnownBrowsers.description: When set to true, IP Surrogate is enforced for all known browsers.

surrogateRefreshTimeUnit.description: The time unit to display for refresh time for revalidation of surrogacy.

surrogateRefreshTimeInMinutes.description: The surrogate refresh time (in minutes) to revalidate the IP surrogates.
